subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers adopt the existing fork PR, ask its author to resolve conflicts, or allow a new narrow same-repo fix PR for the session-recap stripper?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the issue is labeled no-new-fix-pr/linked-pr-open and the linked fork PR is conflicting and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not open duplicate work without explicit direction.

options.title: Allow replacement fix
options.body: Permit a narrow same-repo PR that adds session-recap stripping and regression coverage while crediting the linked fork PR as prior work.

options.title: Ask fork author to repair
options.body: Keep this issue waiting on the fork author to resolve conflicts and provide a landable branch that maintainers can review.

options.title: Keep manual-only
options.body: Leave the issue open without a repair lane until a maintainer manually chooses the ownership path.

recommendation.title: Allow replacement fix
recommendation.body: Permit a narrow same-repo PR that adds session-recap stripping and regression coverage while crediting the linked fork PR as prior work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc merged the original shared metadata-stripper PR and appears in the recent current-main history for the affected file.
